description:
! NOTICE: We are the official partner of Minecraft Chinese Edition (Agent of NetEase).

Due to NetEase's regulations, only the Chinese version is allowed access to join the server.

Download the Minecraft Chinese Edition: https://mc.163.com/

EaseCation, which was founded in 2015, is a minigame/PVP server based on Minecraft, a popular sandbox creative game. Our server has been improving since the foundation. We've been receiving a lot of favorable comments. 

Here, you can enjoy yourself in a variety of modes of Player Versus Player, or you could try out some of our best minigames on the server! The most popular games include Murder Mystery, Build UHC and Mega Walls. At present, the number of daily active players is around 10,000, with a total registration of more than 40 million.

Enjoy a variety of minigames!

We have more than 20 types of minigames for you to play. Fight your way out in Mega Walls? Become a detective and see through the murder's scheme in Murder Mystery? Push your eyesight and reaction into the limit in Colorblind Party? Or having a deadly duel with another player in Build UHC? We've got you covered.

Teaming up with your friends!

You can team up with your best friends and play all kinds of minigames together via the Teaming System built on the server. Go rush to the top of the podium with your friends!

Titles and Pets!

You can get your own titles and pets via lucky draws and events, all kinds of elaborately designed models and decorative will surely enrich your gaming experience.
